title: The Frobenius–Hopf contact structure is a universal computer
html:
Remark. The Frobenius–Hopf contact structure is a universal computer

The categorical Reeb derivation \xi_q arises from the Frobenius pairing and the Hopf algebra structure on A via the Cartan magic formula \mathcal{L}_{\xi_q}\varTheta = 0, \iota_{\xi_q}\varTheta = 1. The horizontal projection of \xi_q onto the state bundle \mathcal{S} is the Reeb vector field of the contact form \varTheta.

Cardona–Miranda–Peralta-Salas–Presas prove that on any closed 3-manifold equipped with a contact form, a Reeb vector field whose first-return map encodes a universal Turing machine exists. The trajectory-reachability problem for such fields is undecidable. The Reeb flow is computationally universal in the classical sense of Church and Turing.

Because \xi_q is the Reeb derivation of a contact form \varTheta on the state bundle, every fibre \mathcal{S}_p inherits the structural capacity to embed a Turing-complete Reeb flow. Universal computation is a property the quantum observable universe inherits from the contact geometry that the Frobenius–Hopf substrate forces on \mathcal{S}.

The same Reeb flow that replaces the prime-counting logarithm by a periodic-orbit spectrum acts metrically as a universal computer. The discrete roots-of-unity specialisations are the quantum-mechanical shadow of this classical universal computer. The contact geometry on \mathcal{S} generates universal computation natively.
